title: Add About the Creator page copy and app-wide footer copyright text

requirements.text: Update the "About the Creator" page to display the exact user-provided child-voice text using the creator name "Gabriella Gayle" and include the bottom copyright line "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. All rights reserved." The typography must remain small, calm, and child-friendly.

quotes:
Add a new page called About the Creator and link it in the footer of every screen.
The page should display this text written in a child voice:
About the Creator
Hi, I’m [Gabriella Gayle] and I’m 9 years old.
I created My Health Buddy because I have  health issue so I have to visit hospital a lot and sometimes it is hard to explain how my body feels.
I wanted to help children like me show their feelings quickly so trusted adults can understand and help.
This app was my idea and I helped design how it works.
Thank you for using my app 💛
At the bottom add:
© 2026 [Gabriella Gayle]. All rights reserved.
...
Keep all text small, calm and child-friendly.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the About the Creator page shows the heading "About the Creator" and the exact paragraphs as provided by the user, including the 💛 character.
The About the Creator page includes a bottom line that reads exactly: "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. All rights reserved."
The text on the About the Creator page is styled in a small, calm, child-friendly way (e.g., small font size and gentle contrast consistent with existing app styling).

requirements.text: Update the app-wide footer copyright line on every screen to read exactly: "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. My Health Buddy and the Luma character are original creations. All rights reserved." Keep the footer text small, calm, and child-friendly.

quotes:
Also add a small footer on every screen showing:
© 2026 [Gabriella Gayle]. My Health Buddy and the Luma character are original creations. All rights reserved.
Keep all text small, calm and child-friendly.

acceptanceCriteria: Every screen that shows the footer displays exactly: "© 2026 Gabriella Gayle. My Health Buddy and the Luma character are original creations. All rights reserved."
The footer text remains small and visually calm (consistent with existing footer styling).

requirements.text: Ensure the footer includes an "About the Creator" link/button on every screen that navigates to the About the Creator page (if already on the About the Creator page, the link/button may be disabled or still present but must not break navigation).

quotes: Add a new page called About the Creator and link it in the footer of every screen.

acceptanceCriteria: From the footer on each screen, the user can activate an "About the Creator" link/button to reach the About the Creator page.
The About the Creator link/button does not cause errors when used from any screen (including the About the Creator page itself, if shown there).

requirements.text: Add (or ensure) the following short copyright/originality line appears inside the Privacy & Safety (or Safety) page content, styled small, calm, and child-friendly: "The Luma character, wording, and design of this app are original and protected."

quotes:
Add a short copyright line inside the Safety or Privacy page:
The Luma character, wording, and design of this app are original and protected.
Keep all text small, calm and child-friendly.

acceptanceCriteria: The Privacy & Safety page contains the exact sentence: "The Luma character, wording, and design of this app are original and protected."
The added line is visually small and calm (e.g., uses small text styling consistent with other fine-print content).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (shadcn components are read-only in this environment).
Keep all user-facing text in English, and use the exact copyright wording provided by the user.
Do not introduce any new backend storage or services; this change is frontend-only.
nonGoals: Adding new authentication, accounts, or data collection.
Changing the app’s overall navigation model beyond adding/ensuring the About the Creator footer link.
Creating or modifying any images or illustrations.
